prompt_name: Modern Dark-Purple Developer SaaS Website Inspired by Sentry

reference.source_note: Use the Sentry welcome page only as visual inspiration: dark developer-first SaaS aesthetic, code/UI mockups, product cards, logo wall, testimonials, and strong CTA structure. Do not copy Sentry branding, logo, exact copy, screenshots, or proprietary assets.

main_prompt: Design and build a modern, premium SaaS landing page with a dark-purple developer-tech theme inspired by the visual energy of Sentry's homepage. The website should feel sharp, cinematic, technical, and high-conversion. Use a deep purple-black background, layered gradients, glowing accents, animated code panels, terminal-style cards, dashboard mockups, subtle noise texture, grid overlays, and smooth scroll-based motion effects. The design must look original, not a clone, while capturing the same polished developer-tool atmosphere.

brand_direction.style: Modern developer SaaS, dark mode, premium, technical, confident, slightly playful but professional
avoid: Do not copy Sentry exact layout
Do not make it look like a fake Sentry website

typography.heading_font: Modern geometric sans-serif such as Inter, Geist, or Satoshi
typography.code_font: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, or IBM Plex Mono
typography.heading_style: Large compressed-feeling hero typography, tight tracking, bold weight, strong contrast

layout.spacing: Generous vertical spacing with compact technical cards
layout.card_style: Dark translucent surfaces, soft inner borders, gradient strokes, subtle glow on hover

interactive: Hover glow on buttons and cards
Dashboard panels sliding gently on scroll
effects.motion_principles: Smooth, restrained, premium. Use motion to guide attention, not distract.

requirements: Sticky top navigation with translucent dark-purple blur
Right buttons: Sign In, Get Demo, Get Started
Animated terminal or product dashboard mockup on the right
Background radial glow and subtle grid
Add small pill label above headline such as 'Developer-first platform'

sample_copy.headline: Find the signal. Fix what matters. Ship faster.
sample_copy.subheadline: A modern command center for teams that need full context across errors, performance, users, releases, and AI-powered debugging.

requirements: Horizontal marquee of fictional customer logos
Add text: 'Trusted by fast-moving engineering teams'
Create 4 premium cards in a responsive grid
Each card should include a small icon, heading, short copy, and mini UI visual
Use developer product concepts such as monitoring, AI insights, traces, release context

cards.title: Monitor in minutes
cards.description: Drop in a lightweight SDK and start seeing meaningful issues without complex setup.

cards.title: Root cause faster
cards.description: Connect logs, traces, sessions, and releases into one clear debugging path.

cards.title: Prevent regressions
cards.description: Surface risky changes before they become production incidents.

cards.title: Stay in flow
cards.description: Bring context into your workflow through Git, chat, and issue tracking integrations.

requirements: Create a wide dark dashboard section showing Issue → Context → Fix
Use three connected panels with animated lines
Split layout with copy on left and AI/code diff visual on right
Use purple and lime highlights for suggested fix states
Include small status chips such as 'Root cause detected', 'Patch ready', 'Owner mapped'
Three testimonial cards with fictional names and companies
Dark cards with subtle gradient borders
Tabbed code block with frameworks: Next.js, React, Node.js, Python

sample_copy.headline: Start building with full context.
sample_copy.subheadline: Give your team the visibility to fix faster and ship with confidence.

buttons.primary: Bright purple gradient button with soft glow, rounded pill shape, hover lift
buttons.secondary: Transparent dark button with thin purple border and hover background

cards.style: Glassmorphism dark cards with gradient stroke, inner shadow, and hover glow
cards.hover: Slight translateY, border brightening, glow expansion

code_blocks.style: Terminal window with top-left control dots, syntax highlighting, blinking cursor

icons.style: Thin-line technical icons, rounded, purple/lime accents

technical_instructions.responsive: Must work beautifully on desktop, tablet, and mobile
technical_instructions.performance: Use lightweight effects, avoid heavy 3D unless optimized

negative_prompt: No overly bright neon cyberpunk look
final_output_expectation: Generate a complete, polished, production-ready landing page with a dark-purple Sentry-inspired developer SaaS aesthetic, original branding, strong visual hierarchy, premium animations, responsive layout, and reusable design-system components.
